# Essential Italy

> > Essential Italy offers luxury villa and hotel rentals across Italy's most beautiful regions including Tuscany, Puglia, Sardinia, Sicily, and Umbria.

Essential Italy specializes in curated Italian holiday accommodations, from restored villas with private pools to boutique apartments and family resorts. The site features properties across Southern Italy and classic destinations, with expert guides to regional attractions, cuisine, and culture.

## Tuscany Properties

- [Casa Geremia | Villa with Pool in Crespina, Tuscany](https://www.essentialitaly.co.uk/tuscany/villas/casa-geremia): 4-bed restored Tuscan villa in Crespina near Pisa with private pool
- [Villa Vallebuia](https://www.essentialitaly.co.uk/tuscany/villas/villa-vallebuia): 5-bed luxury villa near San Gimignano with pool & countryside views
- [Fattoria San Martino: Eco Agriturismo Montepulciano](https://www.essentialitaly.co.uk/tuscany/hotels/fattoria-san-martino): Eco-friendly agriturismo near Montepulciano with organic pools & dining

## Sardinia Accommodations

- [Villa Villa Romasinu](https://www.essentialitaly.co.uk/sardinia/villas/villa-romasinu): 2-bed villa in Isola Rossa, Sardinia with pool & Hotel Relax amenities
- [Il Pagliaio Sardinia | Country Villa with Pool & Restaurant](https://www.essentialitaly.co.uk/sardinia/villas/il-pagliaio): Stone villa in rural Arzachena with shared pool & on-site restaurant
- [Resort & Spa Le Dune Sardinia | All-Inclusive Family Holiday](https://www.essentialitaly.co.uk/sardinia/hotels/le-dune-village): All-inclusive family resort in Badesi with 6 pools, spa & kids' club

- [The Temple Apartment: Boutique Stay in Nardò](https://www.essentialitaly.co.uk/puglia/apartments/temple-apartment): Boutique studio in 17th-century palazzo near Piazza Salandro, Nardò
